representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands comparison-panel for few high-density location options with decide as the verb: screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show a 4-candidate × 10-dimension comparison matrix as the primary object; app.js:20-38 defines dims/groups, app.js:40-61 defines 4 location candidates with map coordinates; a street map with commute routes to the company anchor (index.html:24-84, app.js:64-69) matches object_type=location.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Both screenshots: the comparison matrix occupies ~2/3 of the initial screen with per-dimension best-value '优' tags, weighted total row with rank chips and '推荐' badge (app.js:188-197), plus a persistent decide panel bottom-right (app.js:384-391) and header chip '未落定 · 比较后选定候选' (index.html:17, app.js:359) — the decide job is dominant on load.

time_to_understand.evidence: index.html:14-15 title/subtitle states the job verbatim ('4 个候选公寓 · 地理语境与决策输入同屏 · 比较后就地落定'); screenshots show labeled panes ('街区语境' index.html:22, '比较维度' index.html:95), candidate headers with name+tag, grouped row labels with units, and a legend (index.html:87, app.js:310-314) — what/where is conveyed immediately despite high density.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen, zero navigation modes: map and table are siblings under #main (index.html:20-101); selection is one click on the column head (app.js:148) or map pin (app.js:303), decide is one further click on the always-visible panel button (app.js:382-383). No routes, tabs, or pages exist in source.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: select/decide toggle state classes on the same cells, pins, and header (app.js:324-351); the decided state persists on-screen as column highlight, '已落定 ✓' badge (app.js:146), header chip (app.js:357), and panel swap with '重新比较' (app.js:368-373) — no modal, dialog, or route change anywhere in source.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are map + matrix + footer weight/decide bar (index.html:20-110); the 6 sliders, 4 presets (app.js:222-262), and decide panel all feed the weighted score that drives the decide verb ('随偏好权重实时更新' app.js:188), matching the brief's 'decision inputs same-screen' success criterion; no decorative chrome or unused controls found.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4/7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Consistent code-level findings: 12px type floor (styles.css:19), street labels #8A8578 on #E7E4DA blocks ≈2.9:1 (styles.css:77,95), small targets (.btn-select padding 3px/10px styles.css:144-147; range height 18px styles.css:213), and a clickable non-focusable column-head th (app.js:148). Positive affordances exist (:focus-visible styles.css:29; pin role=button with keyboard handlers app.js:291-306; sr-only caption index.html:92; keyboard test _ktest.mjs:49-66) but the objective receipt failures govern.

frontend_rework.evidence: Receipt: layout.overflow pass, layout.responsive_collision pass, text.truncation pass, target_invalid false (measurement-summary.json:11-13,18) — no error failures implying rework. Both viewports render without overlap or truncation; at 1280x860 the last matrix row (周边配套) is clipped at the pane edge but the pane scrolls (styles.css:124), so content stays reachable — cosmetic only.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '地理语境与决策项同屏': the map aside (index.html:21-88) sits beside the table section (index.html:90-100) in one viewport in both screenshots; map pins carry candidate names matching column headers (app.js:300-302), dashed commute routes link each candidate to the company anchor (app.js:64-69,279-288), and a legend binds colors to candidates (app.js:310-314).

defects_observed: measurement-summary.json: 4/7 checks fail — a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (all non-layout checks; target_invalid: false)

scores.overall_note: The package is a faithful, structurally excellent realization of the decide × comparison-panel brief: a single screen pairs a labeled street-context map (SVG, index.html:24-84) with a 4-candidate × 10-dimension comparison matrix (app.js:20-61,176-218), weighted scores and ranks recompute live from six sliders (app.js:92-117,222-262), and the select→decide flow stays in place with the decision persisting on-screen (app.js:324-392), directly satisfying the acceptance seed of geographic context and decision inputs sharing the screen; initial render is synchronous with inline data and no load state (app.js:418-432). The one substantive weakness is accessibility: the sanitized receipt fails all four a11y/type checks (contrast, focus order, target size, minimum projected type size), and the source corroborates plausible causes (12px small-text floor, ≈2.9:1 street-label contrast, sub-24px buttons/sliders, a clickable-but-unfocusable column head), even though visible a11y intent is present (aria labels and pressed states, :focus-visible styling, sr-only table caption, and a keyboard-walk test script). Layout quality is clean at both viewports with no truncation or overflow failures; the only visual nit is the last matrix row clipped at the pane edge at 1280x860, reachable via the pane's own scroll. Task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain not observable in this blind pilot, and model-judged time-to-understand here is a proxy, not a human measurement.
